channel.title: DML news and projects (for SharePoint)
channel.description: News and projects of the DML service group, combined for the IAT intranet news flow.

item.title: DML Presents its Services at the IAT Statusseminar 2026
item.description: At the IAT Statusseminar 2026 we presented the DML service concept, Support, Transfer and Integration, with examples of the work we have already delivered for IAT researchers. The slides are now available online.

item.title: BirdNET-Passage
item.description: Research software for fast, reliable AI classification of bird species across thousands of acoustic sensor recordings.

item.title: Living Lab Workshop Maps
item.description: Print-ready A3 base maps of the five IAT Living Labs, made for drawing and writing on in workshops and events.

item.title: Upcoming Quarto Workshop at iEMSs 2026
item.description: The DML group is organising a workshop at the iEMSs 2026 conference in Dublin

item.title: One Tool to Rule Them All: A Quarto Workshop
item.description: A guided workshop website teaching Quarto for documentation, presentations, manuscripts and outreach — first given at iEMSs 2026.

item.title: Living Lab Explorer
item.description: Interactive dashboards for exploring environmental and socio-economic data from the five IAT Living Labs.

item.title: A how-to guide for Policy Labs
item.description: An interactive guide for developing Policy Labs for Agri-environmental Measures within Living Labs.

item.title: DML at Barcamp Open Science 2026
item.description: DML took part in the 12th Barcamp Open Science in Berlin and moderated a session on how institutions can effectively incentivise Open Science.

item.title: MonksHillLab field ecophysiology handbook web version
item.description: The DML group helped broaden the reach of the MonksHillLab field ecophysiology handbook by moving from a PDF to an interactive web resource.

item.title: DML Presents at IAT Kickoff Meeting
item.description: Members of the DML working group presented at the IAT kickoff meeting, introducing our service concept for supporting researchers with data and modelling needs.

item.title: DML at the FAIRagro Community Summit
item.description: DML working group members attended the FAIRagro community summit, engaging with the FAIR data community in Agricultural research.

item.title: IAT ZALF Templates
item.description: Templates for producing presentations and documents consistent with the IAT and ZALF branding.
